{{Quote|Our luck changed when Vaylin's fleet sacked Dubrillion. After that, there... wasn't much left to be king of anymore. He fled, along with his nobles.|[[Risha Drayen]]|<ref name="KotET" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] was '''sacked''' by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]]'s [[Eternal Fleet]] during the [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]]. Most of the planet was devastated and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Actavarus III]] fled the planet with his nobles.<ref name="KotET" />
